_: Kill-check for asc-zser: the PATH export the generated hook writes, the shim it points at, and the ignore line that keeps the shim out of git. Each mutant breaks ONE line the feature added and names the test that must notice. The kill is what proves the test is measuring this line rather than passing for an unrelated reason -- the two failure modes here (a shim written correctly but not executable, a printf whose escapes are wrong) both produce a file that looks right and does nothing, so a spec that only asserted bytes would go green over a dead install.
